nodes.name: Any workflow failed
nodes.notes: Fires for every workflow that names this one as its error workflow (Settings → Error Workflow, per workflow). Without it a failed execution is a red row in a list nobody opens — and an automation that fails silently is worse than one that was never built, because it is trusted.

nodes.name: Tell the team
nodes.notes: Names the workflow, the node and the actual error, and links to the execution. A bare 'something failed' costs the same to send and is worth nothing at 2am.
